  • Constructor Details

    • EnergyPort

      public EnergyPort(String balanceId, String equipmentSemanticObjectId, String portSemanticObjectId, EngineeringDiagramEnergyBalanceTable.EnergyKind energyKind, EngineeringDiagramEnergyBalanceTable.EnergyDirection direction, String sourceReference, EngineeringDiagramBalanceTable.EvidenceState evidenceState)
      Creates one explicit heat-transfer or shaft-work port.
      Parameters:
      balanceId - stable balance identity
      equipmentSemanticObjectId - canonical equipment or control-volume identity
      portSemanticObjectId - stable port identity, distinct for parallel energy connections
      energyKind - kind of energy crossing the port
      direction - explicit direction relative to the control volume
      sourceReference - source or register reference for the port declaration
      evidenceState - review evidence state
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if an identity, source, kind, direction, or evidence state is missing
